title: Relax-and-Sparsify Approximation Algorithms for Sparse Ridge Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.19738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies sparse ridge regression in the low-rank, high-dimensional setting that often arises when data collection is expensive. By exploiting the low-rank structure, we develop approximation algorithms within a relax-and-sparsify framework: solve a convex relaxation and then sparsify its solution to satisfy the original sparsity constraint. Specifically, we establish a tight rank-dependent sparsity bound for the convex relaxation by decomposing its support into two parts. This decomposition in turn motivates two approximation strategies, parameter reduction and binary redistribution, each exploiting a different part. Experiments on synthetic and real datasets show that the binary redistribution algorithms outperform the benchmarks in most instances.

translated_title: 稀疏岭回归的松弛-稀疏化近似算法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了低秩、高维设定下的稀疏岭回归问题，这一设定常在数据采集成本高昂时出现。通过利用低秩结构，我们在“松弛-稀疏化”框架内开发了近似算法：先求解凸松弛问题，再对其解进行稀疏化以满足原始的稀疏性约束。具体而言，我们通过将凸松弛解的支撑集分解为两部分，建立了紧的、依赖于秩的稀疏性界。这一分解进而启发了两种近似策略——参数削减和二元重分配，每种策略分别利用不同的部分。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，二元重分配算法在大多数情况下优于基准方法。
tldr: 本文针对低秩高维设定下的稀疏岭回归提出“松弛-稀疏化”近似框架，通过分解凸松弛解的支撑集建立了紧的秩依赖稀疏界，并据此设计出参数削减与二元重分配两种近似策略，其中二元重分配算法在实验中表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a relax-and-sparsify approximation framework for sparse ridge regression in low-rank, high-dimensional settings, establishing a tight rank-dependent sparsity bound by decomposing the convex relaxation's support into two parts and developing two approximation strategies—parameter reduction and binary redistribution—with binary redistribution outperforming benchmarks in most experiments.
